approval_evidence.quote: Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals ... 04/28/2005 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity STANDARD (NDA 021773, Company: ASTRAZENECA AB; BYETTA EXENATIDE SYNTHETIC INJECTABLE;SUBCUTANEOUS)

series_start_reason: Byetta was approved in 2005 (Amylin/Lilly) and launched long before AstraZeneca printed it, so launch_quarter is null: none of the documents fetched dates the launch. AstraZeneca printed a Byetta row from the Q4 2012 announcement (0001191638-13-000103; 47 in the quarter, 74 for 2012) but until 2014 it is AstraZeneca's share of Bristol-Myers Squibb alliance revenue ('The Company's share of Byetta and Bydureon revenues in the US was $69 million' in Q1 2013; US only until the alliance 'assumed responsibility for promotion in Rest of World markets from April 2013'), and the Q1 2014 announcement (0001191638-14-000608) blends one month of that share with two months of consolidated sales after AstraZeneca 'began reflecting 100 percent ownership' on 1 February 2014. Q2 2014 is the first full quarter of one consistent worldwide product-sales line.
series_end_reason: The Q1 2022 results announcement (6-K filed 2022-04-29, 0001654954-22-005571) lists the CVRM medicines Farxiga, Brilinta, Lokelma, Roxadustat, Andexxa, Crestor, Seloken/Toprol-XL, Bydureon, Onglyza and 'Others' with no Byetta row, and no 6-K filed after 2022-02-11 contains a numeric Byetta row. The last quarterly row is Q4 2021 (10) in the Q4 2021 announcement of 2022-02-10; the Form 20-F filed 2022-02-22 prints the full year 2021 (55), and the Forms 20-F for 2022 and 2023 print Byetta only for 2021 and 2020 (55 and 68), never for their own year.
notes: Quarters read from the World column of the quarter's own announcement (2014: 'Product Revenue Analysis'; 2015 onward: 'Product Sales'); 2016Q1-2017Q1 are cited from the announcement's first Product Sales table, which agrees with the later regional table. Each year's quarters sum to the full-year figure printed in the Q4 announcement within 1 (2020: 69 vs 68). Not joined: Bristol-Myers Squibb (CIK 14272) printed Byetta net sales from the Q3 2012 10-Q (55) through 2013 (85 for Q1 2013) in its own filings, with no stated geography and no line for 2014Q1; Amylin Pharmaceuticals (CIK 881464) filings were indexed but their documents were not read, and Amylin's US-only Byetta lines are not spliced on.
search_log: Listed AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 0000901832) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages): 2,052 filings of every form type, 6-K/A and 20-F/A included.

Fetched the main document of 1,638 of them (1,607 6-K, 6 6-K/A, 24 20-F, 1 20-F/A; filed 2002-11-05 to 2026-10-05) into a local cache and scanned them as table rows (cells joined by ' | ') by row label; AstraZeneca 6-Ks before November 2002 are not in the cache.

Located each quarterly results announcement as the 6-K in the filing window of the quarter that contains the Symbicort product-sales row, then read the brand row from that same announcement (the quarter's own release), not from a later comparative column.

Latest results document used for the end of the data: the Q2 2026 results 6-K filed 2026-07-27 (0001104659-26-086846); no later results announcement is in the filing list (latest filing 2026-10-08, not a results release).

Checked AstraZeneca's investor-relations results page (astrazeneca.com/investor-relations/results-and-presentations.html): the only Excel files it links are two epidemiology workbooks, and no product-sales Excel data book was found, so the sec.gov 6-K tables are the source.
Bigdata.com was not needed; every figure was read from the sec.gov original document.

Scanned every cached 6-K for rows labelled Byetta: first numeric row is the Q4 2012 announcement (47, FY 74), a share-of-alliance-revenue measure; the Q1 2013 announcement reads 'The Company's share of Byetta and Bydureon revenues in the US was $69 million'.

Compared each quarter's first medicine table with the World column of the regional Product Sales analysis table: identical in all 31 quarters (for 2016Q1-2017Q1, against the later World-column row of the same announcement).
Summed quarters against the full-year figures printed in the Q4 announcements and the Form 20-F for 2021: equal or within 1.

Searched 6-K and 20-F filings from 2022-02-11 for a numeric Byetta row: only the Forms 20-F filed 2022-02-22, 2023-02-21 and 2024-02-20 (full-year 2021 and earlier comparatives); no quarterly 6-K prints Byetta after Q4 2021.
Read Bristol-Myers Squibb 10-Q/10-K filings 2012-2013 for Byetta net sales (not joined); indexed Amylin's filing list but did not read Amylin documents.
Fetched FDA Drugs@FDA overview for NDA 021773 for the approval date.
